title: factdiff.py anchor --quotes for one file keeps the quote anchors another file wrote for a shared source
goal: factdiff.py anchor --file F --quotes CSV re-anchors only the facts of F: a fact of another file citing the same source keeps its quote anchor instead of being re-anchored by plain matching, so a refresh of several articles that share sources needs no scratch script to keep each file's rows (ST-neh4up5t's worker needed one in SP-qjg5r7jj)
